notes.title: New update and Mac OS support
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11275702/9ec1d5e7378d4bc1518f4c1b23134bcac936fdc6.png[/img]

Hi.
 
Version 1.3 is released, and there are the following changes:
[list]
    [*]Mac OS Support
[/list]

Some changes:
[list]
    [*]Changed some sound effects
    [*]Kill counter in Survival mode
    [*]A few changes in the interface
    [*]Units limit increased from 12 to 16
    [*]Now turrets and walls can be built during construction or upgrade

[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed Invincible units
    [*]Fixed a bug with bullets which changed its direction
    [*]Fixed a bug that resulted in stopping waves of enemies in the survival mode
    [*]Debug console no longer appears when you press F12 
    [*]Fixed a bug due to which the last secret level in Survival mode could be unlocked only on "Game Over" screen
    [*]Fixed a bug when Carrier did not produce new Bombers.
[/list]

notes.title: Little update 1.2 is here
notes.notes:
A new update was released. It brings the following changes:

[list]
 [*] Added ability to change the difficulty of the game. (In the options menu)

 [*] Now the difficulty of Survival mode grows more slowly, making it possible to perform some of the achievements (previously impracticable due to the excessive number of enemies).

 [*] Fixed frieze at the time of completion or failure of the mission.

 [*] Added a progress of the text blocks of intro text through a left click.
[/list]

notes.title: The game has been updated to version 1.15
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I just uploaded the new update. It contains the basic things that have been requested by the community!

[i]What's new?[/i]

[list]
[*]Tutorial and intro messages wait for mouseclick.
[*] Music volume control
[*] Sound volume control
[*] Screen's shake control
[*] New menu in the gameplay process with the aforementioned settings
[*] Possibility to cancel the construction of the turret (Right click or Esc)
[*] Advanced Survival mode, with increasing complexity in the process.
[*] Changes in the balance of the last campaign levels (now easier)
[*] Reset progress in the settings is now will apply only to campaign.

[*] Achievments

[*] Fixed Steam overlay (Which in some cases did not appear when you press Shift-tab.)
[*] Fixed several bugs in the gameplay.
[*] Fixed some grammatical errors. (Thanks to My Fighting is Poetry!)
[/list]
